title: jobsQueue
responsibility: Validate explicit queue JSON, capacity overrides and bounded what-if counts, including the current active unit registry.

inputs.name: jobsQueue.options
inputs.description: Parsed CLI flags selecting history home, driver input, explicit queue, capacity or what-if. An omitted home uses HARNESS_JOBS_HOME or the stable per-user directory.

inputs.name: jobsQueue.live
inputs.description: Current read-only queue and capacity snapshot, used unless an explicit queue file replaces it; what-if excludes its running and queued jobs.

outputs.name: jobsQueue
outputs.description: Validated queue with capacity overrides, or a replacement what-if queue without live work. Invalid JSON, counts and required flags throw.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid lifecycle timing, identity or scheduling flags before the operation can record or estimate work.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Invalid explicit queue JSON, unreadable registry inputs or schema violations propagate before scheduling.
